items: off-grid inverter/charger (120 V or 120/240 V split-phase)
48 V LiFePO4 battery bank sized in kWh
solar panel array sized in kW
why: ChatGPT split its answer by situation (RV or tiny cabin at 2–5 kWh, small cabin at 5–10 kWh, full-time home at 15–30 kWh with 4–8 kW of panels) and said a permanent off-grid home may be better served by a hybrid inverter with separate LFP batteries, yet it carded only bare power stations (DELTA Pro Ultra, F3800 Plus, Apex 300) and no complete system. Battery kWh, array wattage, and 120 V versus 120/240 V split-phase output decide whether a set can run a well pump or 240 V appliances. Sun Gold Power sells uncarded single-cart kits at three of those sizes: SGM-5K5E (5.12 kWh, 120 V), SGR-8K10E (10.24 kWh, 120/240 V) and SGR-10K20E (20.48 kWh, 120/240 V).
